content: Vite serves files placed in public/ at root path unhashed (e.g. public/audio/a-ah.mp3 -> /audio/a-ah.mp3), accessible via plain string paths (new Audio('/audio/a-ah.mp3')) without import. This is the standard approach for many small non-critical-path audio assets since it avoids per-file import statements; a JS object/map keyed by a predictable id (e.g. letter+niqqud-group id) to public URL string is the idiomatic lookup pattern, trading automatic content-hash cache-busting for simplicity — acceptable for a PWA where workbox precaching (not query-string hashing) handles cache invalidation anyway.
